MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Deck Plus screws felt like a natural next choice because I recently bought bulk #10 outdoor wood screws, and these offer a closely related fastening option.",
    "The screw recommendation matched the wood-fastening work reflected in my history, provided the shorter 3-1/2-inch length suits the job."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Glue, epoxy, and fluorescent tape did not fit my immediate needs: buying nails, screws, and anchors does not mean I currently have a bonding or taping task.",
    "Cutting wheels, grinding discs, and electrical connectors require different tasks or equipment needs that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "My medicine cups and replacement vacuum bags did not give me a reason to buy tubing or four spray bottles, and ten packs of super glue would exceed my current need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions treated a broad connection to construction and repair supplies as enough to make an item useful to me now.",
    "The suggestions seemed to connect isolated household purchases to additional supplies without a clear shared purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of framing nails, wood screws, and mounting anchors point more strongly toward specific fastening needs than general workshop supplies.",
    "Details such as screw diameter, length, outdoor suitability, and package quantity matter to whether I can actually use a suggested fastener.",
    "I choose supplies when they fit a current task; a possible future repair or cleaning use is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my interest in fastening supplies but stretched it into unrelated repair and household tasks."
}
